main_body: Roofed well: a stone drum with a dark water opening (and a bucket) under a snow-covered roof held up by two wooden posts
top_band: At x=15, rows 16-17 are a light grey rim (L=80 to 145). Rows 17-22 show the dark opening ellipse with a brown bucket. Row 23 is a light front-rim line (L=145).
evidence: The ellipse opening is seen from above, with a back rim, an interior (dark water with a bucket) and a light front-rim line at row 23. Below it, rows 24-30 are the stone front face with darker courses, which reads as a separate vertical face. The snowy roof above is a wide light horizontal slab with its own front edge. The roof and base are consistent, as in the roofed-well reference. The stone courses are drawn as flat bands rather than inset, but the opening itself is clearly a visible top surface.

style.evidence: The snow ramp has about 6 steps (f6f9fd, dce5f1, bccade, 97a8c6, 7383a8, 55628a). The stone has about 4 steps and the wood has several browns. Dark edge pixels are 0% neutral, so the outlines are tinted (dark blue-brown) rather than black. Flat-fill coverage is 0%. It has 24 distinct colours and 14 colours per tile, below the references' 38-40 and 17-20 but close. Icicles and snow clumps add texture, so it would sit acceptably next to the references.
